accepted_plan.summary: Refactor Repository Ticket Kanban into grouped frontend component with display-only planning+ready and queued+inprogress groups, priority sort, per-group scroll areas, independent lazy visible counts, original state badges, and design-token styling without backend lifecycle changes.
accepted_plan.role_plan: Orchestrator creates a dedicated child worktree and spawns a narrow-scope frontend Coder. Reviewer will be spawned read-only after Coder reports implementation commit(s). After approval, Orchestrator integrates into `orchestration`, validates Deno/Nix, records closure, and cleans only the child worktree/branch.
